status_definitions.green: Stage evidence meets the current deterministic threshold.
status_definitions.amber: Partial coverage or a known parked/pending dependency.
status_definitions.red: A required stage has no usable coverage, an active hard failure, or a failed run gate.
status_definitions.unknown: The repository does not retain enough evidence to determine health.
status_definitions.not_applicable: The stage does not apply to this pack.

important_limits: A known official URL boundary is not proof that every historical URL has been discovered.
Download holdings are current active-corpus documents, not a completeness claim against an unknowable publisher total.
Metadata health grades year confidence only; exact release-date and reference-period coverage are reported separately.
Parsing coverage is manifest membership plus extraction counters, not proof of semantic correctness for tables.
Last recorded run is durable downloader evidence. No scheduler execution telemetry was found, so last cron is unknown.
health_snapshot.denominator_note: Asset and parse coverage in the current health artifact uses every downloaded document linked to a pack. The selective 763-document plan is the intended execution denominator and must replace that broad denominator after the first bounded parse run.
